basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow (Centre for Atmospheric Sciences) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in any discipline of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences with 80% or above aggregate marks, first class in bachelor's degree, and NET/GATE qualified. NET/GATE may be relaxed for CFTI graduates with CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).
qualification.details: Qualification: A Master's degree in any discipline of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences with 80% or above aggregate marks; First class in bachelor's degree; NET/GATE qualified; NET/GATE requirement may be relaxed for candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks) Experience: Desired experience: Experience in numerical atmosphere and ocean modeling | Other conditions: | Applications are invited from Indian nationals only | Desirable: | Experience in numerical atmosphere and ocean modeling

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
Fill the form with complete information on educational qualifications, indicating percentage of marks/division, and details of work experience.
Send the filled form by e-mail to Prof. Vimal Koul at [email protected].
Write the advertisement number on the subject line of the e-mail.
important_instructions: 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates Eligibility clarifications: contact Prof. Vimal Koul at [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A Master's degree in any discipline of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences with 80% or above aggregate marks; First class in bachelor's degree; NET/GATE qualified; NET/GATE requirement may be relaxed for candidates who have graduated from Centrally Funded Technical Institutes (CFTIs) with a CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks) Experience: Desired experience: Experience in numerical atmosphere and ocean modeling Other conditions: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only Desirable: Experience in numerical atmosphere and ocean modeling

content_sections.text: Salary of a selected retired/superannuated government employee will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Jr. Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 23 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.37,000 p.m. plus HRA @27% (consolidated fellowship).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in any discipline of Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences with 80% or above aggregate marks, first class in bachelor's degree, and NET/GATE qualified. NET/GATE may be relaxed for CFTI graduates with CGPA of more than 8.000 (80% aggregate marks).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications are invited from Indian nationals only.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Short-listing of eligible candidates (IIT Delhi may fix higher criteria). Online interview. IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing. Names of short-listed candidates and online interview details will be displayed on http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on contractual basis with consolidated pay. Subject to periodic performance review. Renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.answer: Centre for Atmospheric Sciences, IIT Delhi, New Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
